summary: @or-sdk/graph preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB sibling bundle
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is written in obfuscator.io style (identifiers mangled to _0xNNNN, string constants relocated into per-function helper objects) and at npm install time downloads a Bun runtime for the detected platform from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle carrying the standard string-array + array-rotation obfuscator (rotator WV8StW, string decoder hc1jfK9, hex-mangled identifiers). The advertised purpose of the package is a graph/Neo4j SDK, which has no need to fetch a second language runtime at install and run a large opaque bundle through it. The install-time payload runs under a freshly-downloaded interpreter rather than under Node, which routes execution around static tooling that follows only Node-reachable code. This is the alternate-runtime dropper shape: obfuscated preinstall + fetched non-Node runtime + obfuscated non-inspectable sibling bundle executed on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
